title: DeploymentRoute
responsibility: Displays accessible source-to-destination labels and a directional arrow for a deployment.

inputs.name: DeploymentRoute.deployment
inputs.description: A DeploymentActivity projection containing sourceEnvironment, environment, and branch; sourceEnvironment may be null. The component displays sourceEnvironment when present and falls back to branch when it is null, while environment must be one of dev, stage, preprod, or prod.

outputs.name: DeploymentRoute
outputs.description: Accessible markup with a labeled group, source and destination labels, and a right-arrow separator; it displays sourceEnvironment or falls back to branch when null. The source uses branch styling on fallback, and long labels wrap within the inline route.
